summary: Iteration 2 verification of Pavlovića med refactor (3 products, real brand/contact, AI-generated jar images served from /api/static). Backend: 11/11 pytest passing (root, products count/IDs/prices/weights/image paths, static png images 200+image/png content-type, contact CRUD+validation, list excludes _id). Frontend: All 13 requested checks pass — Navbar/Footer brand 'Pavlovića med', hero tagline + Lazarevac, bagremov/suncokretov/livadski mentioned, only 2 About stats (20+ + 100%, old 40+ and 1.000+ removed), 3 product cards with backend-served jar images all loading (naturalWidth=1024), Poruči on Bagremov scrolls to contact and prefills subject 'Porudžbina: Bagremov med', real contact info (063 432 016, zeks75@gmail.com, @honey_of_pavlovich_family, Lazarevac), footer year 2026, contact form POST returns 200 and form clears on success.

integration_issues.issue: Observed one transient error toast 'Greška prilikom slanja. Pokušajte ponovo.' during the first submit attempt; immediate re-run with identical payload returned HTTP 200 and cleared the form. Network capture confirmed backend responded 200. Likely a transient network/route issue, not a code defect — but worth keeping an eye on. No reproducer found.

design_issues.screen: Contact form (carried over from iteration 1, still applies)
issues: <input required> on name/email/message blocks empty-submit via native HTML5 validation, so the toast.error('Molimo popunite obavezna polja.') branch is unreachable. Add noValidate to <form> if toast feedback is desired. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: static files mounted at /api/static AFTER include_router(api_router) — this is correct; the explicit '/api/static' mount path ensures Kubernetes ingress routes it to backend. Verified all 3 PNGs return 200 with content-type image/png.
server.py: PRODUCTS hard-coded list is fine for this MVP scope; consider moving to MongoDB only if admin CRUD is added later.
Products.jsx resolveImage() correctly handles both absolute (http*) and relative (/api/static/*) paths, prepending REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — clean.
Contact.jsx still uses `required` on inputs which silently disables the JS validation toast branch (minor, noted in iteration 1).
seed_data_creation: Pytest seeded 2 TEST_ contact_messages (TEST_Marko, TEST_Seed2). Playwright submitted 'TEST Diagnostic' and 'TEST_JSFetch' rows. All visible in GET /api/contact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py pass (root, products structure, 3 static PNG images, contact create/validation/list). Frontend external URL: https://pcelji-zaklon.preview.emergentagent.com. Key data-testids: product-order-{id}, contact-submit, contact-input-{name|email|phone|subject|message}, contact-section, products-section. Subject prefill uses input name='subject'. Footer year is dynamic. The earlier transient submit error did not reproduce; backend returns 200 reliably for valid payloads.
